headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty extended losses as markets remain closed today for Gandhi Jayanti

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Monday, 5 October.

why: Foreign investors sold Indian equities en-masse, triggering heavy capital outflows
Soaring global bond yields and elevated oil prices weighed heavily on market sentiment
Global rate hikes and ongoing macroeconomic pressures prompted extended sell-offs
Benchmark indices suffered an eighth consecutive week of losses
whatHappening: BSE and NSE are closed today, 2 October 2026, for Gandhi Jayanti
On the last trading day, Sensex dropped 570.59 points while Nifty tanked to 22,421.95
Indian benchmark shares posted their longest weekly losing run in 25 years
Bajaj Auto and Max Healthcare were listed among the top losers in the weekly wrap
summary: Indian stock markets are closed today, October 2, for Gandhi Jayanti. In the previous session, benchmark indices extended their downturn with Sensex dropping over 570 points amid foreign institutional selling and global rate concerns. Markets marked their eighth straight week of losses, with stocks like Bajaj Auto and Max Healthcare leading declines.
